title: docs: document initialization and cleanup usage in dissectors
description:
Closes #20312

This adds a section to `README.dissector` explaining how dissector plugins should
handle initialization and cleanup logic. It clarifies the use of `proto_register_*`
and `proto_reg_handoff_*`, and recommends using `pinfo->pool` for temporary memory.
